artifacts.summary: Decides trigger (a) (concrete artifact + existing compiled gate) for a new compile-verify-before-recommending clause in lean-research-agent.md, places it always-on (not hard-mode-only), corrects the dispatch's file scope by removing the nonexistent lean-research-hard-agent.md, and specifies an inline [VERIFIED: PASS/FAIL/No compiled gate applicable] recommendation tag extending both lean-research-agent.md and lean-research-flow.md report skeletons.

memory_candidates.content: In this repo's agent-system, --hard no longer resolves a separate <domain>-<phase>-hard-agent.md file for any extension (lean, cslib, books included) -- that agent-level ladder (routing_agents_hard) is retired. --hard dispatches the SAME agent body as standard mode; hard-mode duties are injected as separate contract files via the manifest's hard_contracts.<task_type> array (replace:/additive entries resolved by routing_lookup_flat()), merged into the dispatch prompt by orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh Stage 3.5. A task description or provenance record that names a '<domain>-research-hard-agent.md' or '<domain>-implementation-hard-agent.md' file should be treated as a stale/incorrect assumption until checked against the manifest's hard_contracts block and the filesystem -- it is not a live file pattern in this codebase.

In this repo's lean extension, lean-research-agent.md's own Stage 1 report skeleton and the shared lean-research-flow.md's Stage 5 report skeleton are two independent copies of the same research-report template, and they have already drifted at least once (lean-research-agent.md carries a '## Tactic Survey Results' evidence table that lean-research-flow.md's parallel template lacks entirely). Any new report-template clause (an evidence section, a required tag) added to one must be mirrored in the other in the same change, or the drift recurs.
